parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-minted key (fleet guideline R3-R5). First use executes; a
replay returns the stored response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`
when the first answer was final for the request — a 2xx or a FINAL
refusal (ADR 0012). A RETRYABLE refusal is not stored: the key is
released and a retry executes again. A key reused with a different
body after a stored answer is `409 idempotency-key-reused`.
A stored answer is replayed for 24 hours after it was stored
(ADR 0012, addendum 2026-11-22); after that the key is free and the
request executes again. A key of 1 to 128 characters is accepted
(the fleet bound); a missing or longer one is
`400 idempotency-key-required`.
